The longer story

Here’s a little story about me.

Once upon a time, in a land called Dubai, I was living away from home for the first time.

Before Dubai, I applied to Qatar Airways. I stood in a long queue outside the hotel, in a blazer and a skirt, with more than 900 other candidates. I made it to the final 14, but didn’t make the final cut. A few days later, Emirates had an opening. There were about 100 of us that time, and I got in.

Three months in Dubai, I was on the phone with my mom, crying, telling her I wanted to go home. I stayed for four years and five months, and asked “chicken or beef?” more times than I can count.

After that, I shaped a surfboard, started a coffee box, taught Tagalog on YouTube and taught myself to tell stories with data. Today, I'm the Lead Storyteller at Good Cup.

The three octopuses on my front page started as keychains I designed for 3D printing. The rest of the story is on the map below.

Off the Clock

Two stories that aren't about work.

  1. 1Sawdust ♡After flying, I wanted to try things I had never done.Gold Coast

    I enrolled myself in a surfboard shaping workshop on the Gold Coast and a carpentry workshop in Manila.

    I once wanted to be a furniture designer and a carpenter.

  2. 2Dear Mom ♡This is a letter to my mom.A letter

    To my anchor.

    I'd like to think my mom was the first person who loved me and the first person I loved, my first connection to this world, literally and figuratively.

    Dear Mom,

    When I was crying on the phone in Dubai, you were the one I called.

    The truth is, I don't know what to write to you yet. I just know it starts with thank you.

The end, for now
